season.evidence: Logged Lakes Lookout ascents peak Jul-Sep (21 of 28); Oregon Hikers/trip pages call summer and early fall best in the Elkhorns, snow possible any month. A friction slab route needs dry rock.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Road and maintained-trail hike to the lookout from Anthony Lake, not a 5.7 slab climb

notes: All logged ascents are trail hikes to the lookout. The only stored route is a 5.7 slab climb, so no hiking track qualifies. The hiking trail is not listed as a missing climbing route.
